title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Aramco, Riyadh

timeline.title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Aramco, Riyadh
timeline.line: Saudi ministry confirms an attempted strike on an Aramco building with minor damage
more: Houthis claimed six operations, including Aramco sites in Khurais and Riyadh airport
Saudi authorities had not confirmed the airport claim
Adds to supply risk just as oil had fallen sharply last week

src.title: ANI: Saudi Energy Ministry confirms attempted strike on Aramco facility in Riyadh after Houthis claim operations
